project.title: Retail Click-and-Collect Service Rollout
project.objective: Design and launch a basic click-and-collect service integrating store, back-office, and delivery operations for a multi-category retail shop.
deliverables: Standard click-and-collect operating procedure for store staff
Back-office order tracking and documentation workflow
Storage and staging layout for click-and-collect orders
Customer communication templates for order status and pickup
Training checklist for sales floor, office, and moving staff
constraints: Service must be operational within 21 days
Use existing POS and office tools, no new software purchases
Storage space for staged orders is limited in each store
Procedures must support fragile and perishable goods
Compliance with basic data protection and receipt retention rules

risks.risk: Orders misplaced or not ready when customers arrive for pickup.
risks.mitigation: Introduce clear labeling, dedicated storage zones, and a mandatory staging checklist for each order.

risks.risk: Staff confusion about responsibilities between sales floor, office, and movers.
risks.mitigation: Define role-specific steps in SOP and run short cross-team briefings before launch.

risks.risk: Perishable or fragile items damaged while being staged or moved.
risks.mitigation: Create handling guidelines by product type and require movers and sellers to confirm packaging steps.

risks.risk: Customer complaints due to unclear communication on pickup times and requirements.
risks.mitigation: Standardize customer messages and ensure office clerks and sales assistants use approved templates.

themes.why_relevant: Office clerks must track orders, invoices, and pickup status consistently across categories.
Sales assistants and specialised sellers need practical ways to stage and store orders safely.
Movers handle bulky or fragile orders and must align with store and office procedures.
All roles interact with customers and must give consistent information on pickup and issues.
New process requires quick training and buy-in from staff with different backgrounds.

backlog.task: Draft end-to-end click-and-collect process map from order placement to pickup confirmation
definition_of_done: Process map covers order intake, payment, staging, pickup, and returns
Responsibilities by role are clearly indicated
Reviewed and accepted by at least one sales assistant and one mover

backlog.task: Define storage and labeling method for staged click-and-collect orders
definition_of_done: Label format for orders is documented
Storage zones and shelf usage are described with examples
Method tested with at least three sample orders from different product types

backlog.task: Create handling guidelines for fragile, bulky, and perishable items in click-and-collect
definition_of_done: Guidelines cover packaging, stacking, and transport within store
Includes specific notes for bakery goods, flowers, and electronics
Reviewed by a flower and garden specialised seller and a bakery-experienced office clerk

backlog.task: Design customer communication templates for order confirmation, ready-for-pickup, and delay notices
definition_of_done: Templates for at least three scenarios are written
Language is clear on pickup window and required documents
Approved by store management or equivalent authority

backlog.task: Set up a simple order tracking sheet for click-and-collect status
definition_of_done: Sheet includes order ID, customer name, items, status, and pickup deadline
Status codes are defined and documented
Tested with at least five mock orders without data loss

backlog.task: Define floral and garden product-specific staging rules for click-and-collect
definition_of_done: Rules cover watering, temperature, and light exposure while staged
Packaging instructions for transport to pickup desk are included
Aligned with general handling guidelines from movers

backlog.task: Prepare a training checklist for store staff on new click-and-collect procedures
definition_of_done: Checklist covers order lookup, staging, handover, and basic troubleshooting
Separate sections for sales floor, office, and movers are included
Pilot training run completed with feedback captured

backlog.task: Define procedure for partial pickups, cancellations, and refunds for click-and-collect orders
definition_of_done: Steps for processing partial pickups and cancellations are documented
Refund handling is aligned with existing POS rules
Sales assistants confirm they can follow the steps at the counter

backlog.task: Plan physical route and timing for movers to support daily click-and-collect staging
definition_of_done: Daily time slots for moving bulky orders to staging area are defined
Route minimizes interference with customers on the floor
Shared with sales assistants and office clerks for feedback

backlog.task: Create a quick reference guide for identifying and preventing common click-and-collect issues
definition_of_done: At least five common issues and resolutions are listed
Includes escalation path for lost or damaged orders
Distributed to all roles involved in the project

backlog.task: Define visual merchandising adjustments for click-and-collect pickup point
definition_of_done: Pickup point location and signage are described
Customer flow to and from pickup point is considered
Does not block existing displays or emergency exits

backlog.task: Document office filing and digital archiving rules for click-and-collect paperwork
definition_of_done: Retention period for order documents is specified
Folder structure and naming conventions are defined
Test retrieval of three sample orders is successful

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on overall click-and-collect process and role responsibilities.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the project and sharing the first draft process map.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the high-level end-to-end click-and-collect process flow.
Confirm which role is responsible for final pickup confirmation to customers.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define practical staging, storage, and handling rules for different product types.
threads_plan.trigger: Sales assistant posts initial proposal for labeling and storage of staged orders.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select the standard labeling format and storage zoning approach.
Agree on final handling rules for fragile, bulky, and perishable items.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Finalize order tracking and documentation workflow for office clerks.
threads_plan.trigger: Office clerk shares draft tracking sheet and filing rules for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the fields and status codes in the order tracking sheet.
Confirm digital and paper archiving rules for click-and-collect documents.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on customer communication templates and exception handling.
threads_plan.trigger: Office clerk posts draft customer message templates and refund procedure.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve standard customer communication templates for launch.
Agree on the process for handling cancellations, delays, and partial pickups.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan training, daily routines, and go-live readiness check.
threads_plan.trigger: Sales assistant shares training checklist and proposes go-live date.

talk_distribution_by_role.role: audio and video equipment specialised seller

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each role posts current blockers on click-and-collect tasks.
Twice-weekly progress summary from an office clerk consolidating status from the tracking sheet.
Weekly 15-minute retro thread on what went well and what needs adjustment in the new process.
Pre-go-live readiness checklist review thread two days before launch.
Post-launch incident log thread to capture and resolve first-week issues.
